scripts.build:static: cross-env STATIC=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_STATIC=1 next build && node scripts/finish-static.mjs
scripts.build:pages: cross-env STATIC=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_STATIC=1 BASE_PATH=/novel-reader NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/novel-reader NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://itsonu.github.io/novel-reader next build && node scripts/finish-static.mjs
scripts.preview:static: npm run build:static && npx serve out
scripts.check: node scripts/check-library.mjs && node scripts/check-chapters.mjs && node scripts/check-sync.mjs && node scripts/check-timing.mjs
